assessments.reasoning: The survey structure detailed on Page 3 lists sections A through N, none of which comprises a separate domestic or care work module. Domestic and care activities are mentioned in questions such as QC29, QF07, and QJ01, but only as reasons for working part-time, reasons for not seeking employment, or as a self-perceived status of inactivity ('casalinga/o'). Thus, the instrument does not contain a dedicated domestic or care work module, treating unpaid care work as a reason for inactivity or limited labor force participation.
